Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，both parts refer to time, so using them together is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，use this for the concrete group of people in the scene; 别人 usually distinguishes other people from the speaker or a particular person.
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了：神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物，就发现一些人一吃植物就生病了，the connector pattern 一……就…… links the observation to its immediate result.
4. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮人们。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃：神农想帮人们，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，use 所以 to connect the cause and its result within one sentence.

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
别人 incorrectly contrasts these people with someone else, while 人们 can refer to the concrete group in the scene.
The original needs the teacher's 看到 form as well as the 一……就…… connection, but the proposed text leaves 一看 in place.
神农想帮别人。 所以想知道…… is already a valid cause-result connection, with the subject omitted naturally in the second sentence.
